summary: Shares functions and values between resources. A resource lists its exports in the manifest under `kcds.exports` and registers them, and others read them by the resource's name.

register.summary: Stores an export under a name listed in `kcds.exports`. Any other name is ignored, with a warning.

params.name: The export's name.
params.value: The function or value to share.

register.example:
// In the manifest of economy: "kcds": { "exports": ["balance"] }
kcds.core.Exports.register('balance', (player) => wallets.get(player.id) ?? 0);
register.exampleLua:
-- In the manifest of economy: "kcds": { "exports": ["balance"] }
kcds.core.Exports.register("balance", function(player) return wallets:get(player.id) or 0 end)
register.exampleCs:
// In the manifest of economy: "kcds": { "exports": ["balance"] }
Exports.Register("balance", new Func<Player, double>((player) => wallets.GetValueOrDefault(player.Id)));

get.summary: Reads one export of another resource. Throws if that resource or export is missing, and warns if your manifest does not list that resource in `requires`.

params.name: The name of the other resource.

get.example:
const balance = kcds.core.Exports.get('economy', 'balance');
kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, `You have ${balance(player)} groschen`);
get.exampleLua:
local balance = kcds.core.Exports.get("economy", "balance")
kcds.core.Chat.sendToPlayer(player, "You have " .. tostring(balance(player)) .. " groschen")
get.exampleCs:
var balance = Exports.Get("economy", "balance");
Chat.SendToPlayer(player, $"You have {balance.Invoke(player)} groschen");
